title: M3-DuplexBench: A Multi-Turn, Multilingual, Multidomain Benchmark for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.29125v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems (FDSDSs) can listen while speaking, enabling natural conversational behaviors such as smooth turn-taking, backchannel handling, and user barge-in handling. However, controlled comparisons of FDSDSs in multi-turn interaction remain challenging, and existing benchmarks offer limited joint coverage of multiple languages, dialogue settings, interaction timing, and response content. We propose M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual, multidomain benchmark for controlled evaluation of FDSDSs. The benchmark jointly evaluates interaction timing and response content in English and Japanese across casual conversation and multi-turn question answering. The English and Japanese question-answering data are derived from a common source corpus, enabling cross-lingual comparisons of timing and content performance. We also provide a reference-conditioned multi-turn setting as an optional diagnostic for examining

translated_title: M3-DuplexBench：面向全双工语音对话模型的多轮、多语言、多领域基准测试
translated_abstract: 全双工语音对话系统（FDSDS）能够在说话的同时进行聆听，从而实现自然的对话行为，例如流畅的话轮转换、附和处理（backchannel）以及用户插话处理。然而，在多轮交互中对FDSDS进行受控比较仍然具有挑战性，且现有基准测试在多种语言、对话设置、交互时机和响应内容的联合覆盖方面较为有限。我们提出了M3-DuplexBench，这是一个用于FDSDS受控评估的多轮、多语言、多领域基准测试。该基准测试在英语和日语下，针对闲聊对话和多轮问答任务，联合评估交互时机与响应内容。英语和日语的问答数据源自同一源语料库，从而支持跨语言的时机与内容性能比较。此外，我们还提供了一个基于参考的多轮设置，作为检验……的可选诊断手段（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了M3-DuplexBench，一个用于全双工语音对话系统的多轮、多语言（英语与日语）、多领域基准测试，可联合评估交互时机与响应内容，并支持跨语言比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes M3-DuplexBench, a multi-turn, multilingual (English and Japanese), multidomain benchmark for full-duplex spoken dialogue systems that jointly evaluates interaction timing and response content and enables cross-lingual comparisons.
